source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by white)
view: top-down (bird's-eye) orthographic-looking view of a water scene; background is plain white
units: pixels and seconds; image x to the right, y downward; t = frame/24

camera.motion: static (dock centroid constant within 0.7 px over all 37 frames, see tracks/dock_check.csv)
camera.perspective: none visible; 2D scene, boat and dock treated as one plane at one scale

objects.name: boat
objects.description: small rowing boat / dinghy seen from above: lens/leaf-shaped hull, grey-blue rim, light planked interior; pointed end on the right (+x), rounded end on the left (-x)
objects.distinguishing: the only moving object; lies just below (larger y than) the dock
objects.reference_point: mask centroid (top view => approximates object origin/centre)
objects.size_note: mask length decreases slowly 226 -> 216 px as the boat speeds up (likely edge softening / motion blur of the faint pointed tip); frame 0-8 values (~225-227) are the best estimate of true length. Median over all frames: length ~221, width ~88.8.
objects.motion_summary: translates straight to the LEFT (-x) parallel to the dock, y constant at 643 +/- 0.5 px, no rotation (axis angle -3.2 +/- 0.3 deg). Already moving at frame 0 (~3.5 px/frame) and speeding up steadily to ~12 px/frame by frame 36. Net displacement frame 0->36 = 301.9 px.

objects.name: dock
objects.description: long rectangular wooden pier / jetty / pontoon, pinkish-brown planks running across it, dark posts/shadows along both long edges
objects.distinguishing: large static elongated rectangle above the boat
objects.notes: slightly tilted (right end higher by ~10 px). Boat-hull to dock gap ~9 px (boat top y~600, dock bottom y~590).

relations.boat_fully_alongside_dock: boat bbox right edge x1 reaches the dock's right end x1=1486 at frame 14 (t=0.583 s) and is inside the dock's x-range after that; boat left edge stays inside the dock x-range (>=913) in all frames

events.event: boat already in motion at first frame (no start of motion visible)
boat centre passes dock centre in x
